newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in listless trade with the market looking for fresh factors and some traders sidelined ahead of the release of the U.S. jobless claims and retail sales data tomorrow, dealers said on Wednesday.

The U.S. jobless claims for August shows a forecast of 5.1 percent as compared to July's 5.4 percent and the retail sales figure is expected to show an increase of 0.2 percent compared with a 0.1 percent rise in July.

"There was no fresh factors to move the market today and it will be the same for the next day or until the release of the U.S. jobless claims and retail sales data due on Thursday," a local dealer said.
He added that traders are not opening new positions and are just merely maintaining them.
In short dates, Wednesday/Thursday took a 2/16 percentage point hike to 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent. Week-fixed remained unchanged at 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month, three-months unchanged from Tuesday's 5-3/8 5-1/4 and 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, respectively. Four-months and five-months remained steady at a common 5-1/2 5-3/8 percent, nine-months eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent and twelve-months was unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16 percent.
